claim_ceiling: Dense multilingual-e5 embeddings provide three complementary views to TF-IDF citation hybrids at 22yr/144k scale: (1) superior citation heritage recovery (AUC 0.79-0.85 vs 0.71-0.74), (2) cross-lingual alignment for facts/holdings (Sachverhalt >0.2, Dispositiv >0.1 at 1K sample), (3) linear hybrid complement passing adversarial gates at w=0.3-0.4 but remaining below TF-IDF baseline on jurist preference (JP 0.61-0.67 vs 0.78-0.79). No single representation dominates all metrics. Full 174k evaluation blocked by missing bger_ corpus and ID mapping.
evidence_summary: Citation heritage: 21-22yr AUC 0.79-0.85 (344 pos pairs at 22yr, 100 at 21yr) > 0.75 threshold, beats TF-IDF citation-based (0.71-0.74). Section cross-lingual: Sachverhalt cp_64=0.282 (>0.2), Dispositiv cp_64=0.150 (>0.1), Erwaegungen cp_64=0.094 (<0.1) at 1K sample (359/538/510 decisions). Linear hybrids: 22yr linear_citation_concat w=0.4 JP=0.6725/LangDom=0.6539 PASS; linear_hybrid05_concat w=0.3 JP=0.6115/LangDom=0.7477 PASS; both below TF-IDF baseline JP=0.784/0.789. v14 independent rerun (seed=137) confirms linear_citation_concat (paired_delta_mean=0.039, paired_delta_std=0.021). Negative results: center_projected JP 0.05-0.43 all scales FAIL; true OOS ceiling ~0.53 < 0.7; v18 coarse hierarchy purity 0.65 < 0.7; legal TF-IDF from bge_ corpus FAILS; boilerplate resistance negative; Erwaegungen cross-lingual FAILS. Blockers: no bger_ yearly files 2000-2019, no bge_/bger_ ID mapping, missing parquet 2022-2026, section extraction not at 174k scale. Methodology: frozen harness (config_hash=1674829901d55e83), exact k-NN on 2000-decision stratified subsample, paired delta analysis, explicit success rules (min_mean_jp_delta=0.02, max_jp_delta_std=0.03).
